message.text: Chat now follows Claude's layout in V1, V2 and V3: your messages are tinted pills on the right that hug their text, the assistant's are plain text on the left, both capped at 80% (40rem on a desktop). Merged as b87def39e. Walkthrough with shots at 360 and 1920: /framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/20/session-e00f55c9/chat-layout/walkthrough.md. The read-aloud highlight now finds its bubble by message id.

Landed as b87def39e. Your messages are tinted pills on the right that hug their text and grow while you dictate; the assistant's are plain text on the left; both stop at 80% (40rem on a desktop). One shared file, ext/Chat/bubbles.css, draws V1, V2 and V3. The read-aloud highlight now finds its bubble by message id. Shots and numbers: /framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/20/session-e00f55c9/chat-layout/walkthrough.md. Readmes updated: ext/Chat (layout section), v2, v3, audio/Recite, ux/Dictate.
